name: 15 Motion Design Styles
cost: Free (MIT). Third-party files keep their own licences
works_with: An AI assistant that can write code and run commands, such as Claude Code
short: Fifteen 10-second motion design films an AI made by writing code, each with its style notes, full prompt and source to copy.
what: Each film shows one style, from frame-by-frame line boil and isometric 2.5D to synthwave, pixel art and a 9:16 variety-show edit. There is no image or video generation. The picture is code (SVG, Canvas, WebGL, Three.js, and Blender for the 3D film), and each film's `audio.py` synthesises its music and sound effects. The repo publishes the films, prompts and source so you can send a prompt to your own agent and make your own film.
who: Designers and makers who want a short animated film without a video editor, or a set of tested prompts to start from. If you want the same polish in one go, know that the README says a single run usually doesn't get there.
needs: Python 3.11 or later, for the soundtracks
Optional: the fonts listed in `assets/fonts/README.md`, so the lettering matches

steps.title: Watch the films
steps.text: All 15 play with sound at https://vincentwei1021.github.io/mg-styles-15/, each next to its style notes and prompt.

steps.title: Send a prompt to your agent
steps.text: Open your agent in an empty folder. Open any file in `prompts/` and send the whole prompt block.

steps.title: Make it your own
steps.text: Only `Creative seed` is a specific story. Swap in your own story, brand name, copy and colours, or change `Output` to vertical 1080×1920. Keep `Signature features`, because that's what makes the style recognisable.

steps.title: Review and go again
steps.text: Have a second AI review the film with `rubric.md` and paste the review back. The original films went through make, review and revise twice.

steps.title: Render a film from the source
steps.text: Run these from the repository root.
steps.code:
npm install
pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 demos/01-flat-vector/audio.py          # soundtrack → demos/01-flat-vector/out/audio.wav
node harness/render.mjs demos/01-flat-vector   # render every frame → demos/01-flat-vector/out/video.mp4

try.label: From the README
try.where: Your coding agent, in an empty folder
try.text: Open `prompts/01-flat-vector.md` and send the whole prompt block. Then swap the `Creative seed` story for your own.

watch: The same prompt makes a different film every time.
Your agent writes code and runs commands on your machine to render the film.
The font files aren't in the repo. Without them, the lettering falls back to system fonts.
The instructions in `prompts/` are in Chinese. The prompts themselves are in English.
For your own films, use only assets licensed for commercial use, such as CC0 or OFL. The prompts already ask for this.
